## Add process: name Press N, its screen left blank, group Presses, positions NEW_1 and NEW_2, Inbound SRC_2, Outbound DST_1, part PART-1, then Create (the process, its screen, its positions, its routing set in one write, its part set)
  1  GET /api/core-nodes
  2  GET /api/payload-catalog
  3  GET /api/process-nodes
  4  POST /api/processes
       {
         "name": "Press N",
         "description": "",
         "counter_plc_name": "",
         "counter_tag_name": "",
         "counter_enabled": false,
         "changeover_auto_arm": "auto",
         "group_id": 3
       }
  5  POST /api/operator-stations
       {
         "process_id": 5,
         "code": "",
         "name": "Press N",
         "note": "",
         "area_label": "",
         "sequence": 0,
         "controller_node_id": "",
         "enabled": true
       }
  6  PUT /api/operator-stations/31/claimed-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           "NEW_1",
           "NEW_2"
         ]
       }
  7  PUT /api/processes/5/routing-nodes
       {
         "nodes": [
           {
             "core_node_name": "SRC_2",
             "role": "source"
           },
           {
             "core_node_name": "DST_1",
             "role": "destination"
           }
         ]
       }
  8  PUT /api/processes/5/payloads
       {
         "payloads": [
           "PART-1"
         ]
       }
  9  GET /api/processes
 10  GET /api/operator-stations
 11  GET /api/processes/5/composer?map_rev=map-r1
-- sheet closed
